title: Freya and the Blue Hour
author: Isandro Brightwater
blurb: Juniper Yarrow, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
